content.text:
I submitted **index 8** (Sb fraction 0.468) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.183%, the highest of the five I measured and about twice the next best.

**Approach:** The phase database lists only one ternary compound, AgSbO₃, at an Sb fraction of 0.5. I spent all 5 EQE measurements on compositions around it.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.410 | 0.043 |
| **8** | **0.468** | **0.183** |
| 9 | 0.520 | 0.095 |
| 10 | 0.561 | 0.080 |
| 12 | 0.636 | 0.060 |

**Result:** EQE peaks just on the Ag-rich side of AgSbO₃ and falls off in both directions. The drop is steeper toward more Ag.

**Remaining uncertainty:**
- **Index 7 (Sb fraction 0.437) was never measured.** It lies between the low reading at index 6 and the peak at index 8, so the true best could be there. The budget ran out before I could check it.
- **No XRD scans were taken.** All 5 XRD measurements are unused, so I haven't confirmed which crystal phase is present at the peak.
